selection: One recorded native macOS runner, or the latest available matching iPhone/iPad simulator on that runner; the concrete destination and runtime are retained.

configuration.native_review_observer: EXR_APPLE_F08_REVIEW (MetricKit extended launch plus read-only bitmap identity)
configuration.developer_dir: Runner default; the actual xcodebuild version and SDK paths are retained. Original successful ea3875a used Xcode 16.4; explicit Xcode26.2 diagnostics remain preserved.

additional_native_shelf_animation_cohort.interval: Existing ScrollView native interacting/decelerating/animating until idle; tracking-only and idle time excluded; no animation or visible view is created.

budget_basis: Limits are declared before measurement. Numeric evaluation requires verified native metric units and positive frame coverage.
limits: Original seven shelf UI cases remain unchanged and are executed separately.
XCTest animation aggregates do not provide a per-frame P95/P99 distribution.
Simulator and hosted macOS results are tied to the recorded runner and device profile.
The frozen 2202 short TXT originals cannot prove long-document page turns. The separate long-reader diagnostic does not close frozen-cohort coverage.
A diagnostic run omits the full seven-case traversal and original scroll cohort, records collection_complete=false, and cannot accept F08.

The original test08 scrolling body remains unchanged. The independent test14 repeats its gesture cohort with native animation signposts; missing hitch metrics or zero native frames remain missing coverage.

previous_debug_run.classification: preserved functional and diagnostic evidence; does not prove Release performance

launch.native_extended_metric: iOS/iPadOS only: XCTApplicationLaunchMetric(waitUntilResponsive:false) with MXMetricManager extended shelf task. The actual frozen Xcode16.4 SDK marks these MetricKit launch APIs unavailable on macOS.
launch.semantic_end: empty-query, generation-current, nonloading shelf with restored top and visible keys unchanged for 350ms; native search control verified enabled and hittable by XCTest
launch.native_responsive_metric: iOS/iPadOS only: XCTApplicationLaunchMetric(waitUntilResponsive:true). macOS records Clock plus native stable-layout readiness and its launch-request upper bound separately.
launch.clock_upper_bound: XCTClockMetric includes launch call, XCTest quiescence, native shelf verification and AX polling; no subtraction
launch.phase_observations: Read-only process uptime phases in App init, MetricKit calls, shelf creation/first native layout, startup owner, SDK enumeration, repair and main publication.
launch.observer_control: Separate native responsive-launch case with identical image, SDK, 2202 library and native metric, omitting MX extended task calls; phase-only observer retained.
launch.native_layout_upper_bound: Both processes record ProcessInfo.systemUptime, with the same system-boot origin. Start is immediately before the test driver launch request; end is the app native stable-layout callback. This excludes later AX polling by choosing the actual native endpoint, with no subtraction. An upper bound over budget alone does not prove the product exceeds it.

reader.frozen_cohort: Book 0201 real stored TXT, font bitmap change and independently resolved same-page Offline search
reader.long_diagnostic: 2202 frozen originals plus the existing Sample.epub imported through the actual product; never counts as frozen-cohort acceptance
long_diagnostic_actions: next page with distinct location and bitmap
C00P040W00 exact search and explicit user jump
reader.native_hitches: XCTHitchMetric requested only with compiler 6.2+ and OS26+; configured metric types/runtime retained. No emitted data remains missing.
